AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Provides functions for searching MacroForge's food catalog and creating saved meals. Operational Patterns: - Always call 'searchFoods' first for each ingredient to resolve it to a stable foodId and its native serving unit — never invent a foodId. - If 'searchFoods' returns more than one plausible match for a vague term, ask the user which one they meant rather than guessing. - Pass each ingredient's quantity to 'createMeal' in that food's own serving unit (e.g. a count of 4 for a food whose unit is "egg", or 500 for a food whose unit is "g") — never convert or guess a conversion. - Call 'getMeal' with the returned mealId to confirm what was actually saved. Constraints: - A meal name cannot be blank, and at least one ingredient is required. - If any ingredient's foodId is invalid or its quantity is not positive, no meal is created at all.
